supersedes.correction: Restores the original five required fields. Compatible-string evidence is reported separately and is not substituted for memory_or_reservation_binding.

scope: Offline comparison of the private live T6001 ADT capture with pinned m1n1, omarchy-ane, and omarchy-linux source. No host operation, DTS/driver edit, loading, or application authorization.

known_base_m1_analogue.status: unbooted proposal; it is an analogy only, not T6000 mapping evidence

translation_trace.raw_to_physical: m1n1 ADTNode.get_reg() applies parent ranges. It yields the translated MMIO values recorded above; raw cells alone are not Linux resources.
translation_trace.pmgr: pmgr_adt2dt.py turns each PMGR device into a power-controller node and attaches parents. Its literal node template is `ps_` plus lower-cased PMGR name. For `ANE-SYS-V` that would be `ps_ane-sys-v`, which is not a valid DTS label; a sanitizing naming policy is therefore required before a Linux label can be authored.
translation_trace.dart: m1n1 DART.from_adt reads a selected register instance and compatible. It does not read `sids` or `iommu-parent`; those raw ADT values are not a Linux IOMMU relationship.
translation_trace.linux_consumers: omarchy-ane requests named engine MMIO and named ane IRQ, traverses Linux power-domains, and requires a provider-attached IOMMU domain. Linux apple_dart_of_xlate requires one phandle argument, interpreted as SID. These are Linux DT contracts that an FDT author must construct; they are not Apple ADT properties.

engine_mmio_resource.status: physical candidate observed; Linux consumer binding not resolved
direct_evidence: Live ANE range 0 translated to 0x284000000 size 0x2000000.
engine_mmio_resource.derivable: An FDT author can assign a reg entry the label engine.
engine_mmio_resource.not_derivable: The live ADT does not establish the hardware semantic of range index 0 as the driver engine resource. The unbooted M1 proposal has a different resource shape and cannot prove T6000 semantics.
engine_mmio_resource.missing_evidence: A source-authoritative T6000 ANE binding or a reviewed translation rule that assigns this range to engine.

ane_irq.status: raw interrupt observed; Linux consumer binding not resolved
direct_evidence: ANE has raw interrupt 0x302 with raw parent 0x7e.
ane_irq.derivable: An FDT author can name an IRQ ane only after supplying a valid AIC interrupt specifier.
ane_irq.not_derivable: The raw value lacks the AIC translation, trigger/type, and semantic assignment required by platform_get_irq_byname.
ane_irq.missing_evidence: T6000 AIC/FDT translation evidence for the raw interrupt and a source-backed ANE IRQ role.

direct_evidence: The live ANE node has asc-dram-mask, segment-ranges, __TEXT/__DATA segment names, function-mcc_dataset M$DS, and pre-loaded=1.
memory_or_reservation_binding.driver_consumer_status: The current driver has no memory-region, reserved-memory, dma-ranges, or dma-coherent consumer.
memory_or_reservation_binding.not_derivable: None of the observed properties establishes Linux reserved memory, an IOMMU aperture, firmware-owned reservation, or that no reservation is required. The M$DS function phandle did not resolve to a node phandle during offline traversal; no namespace meaning is inferred.
memory_or_reservation_binding.missing_evidence: A T6000 firmware/ADT-to-FDT rule or runtime contract explaining the memory and pre-loaded/function dataset path.

power_domains.status: PMGR ancestry derived; Linux phandle list unresolved
direct_evidence: ANE gate 0x1cf is PMGR device ANE-SYS-V; its PMGR parent is ANE_SYS_CPU.
power_domains.derivable: m1n1's PMGR translator deterministically supplies a power-controller node and parent edge, but its literal generated symbol requires DTS-safe sanitization for this PMGR name.
power_domains.not_derivable: Neither exact driver-facing power-domains list nor ordering follows from the gate alone.
power_domains.missing_evidence: The T6000 ANE node-to-PMGR provider mapping and ordered supplier list.

dart_iommu_relationship.status: DART and raw SID candidates observed; Linux relationship unresolved
direct_evidence: dart-ane0 is dart,t6000 with four translated 0x4000 windows and raw SID 0xa001; ANE has raw iommu-parent 0x14b.
dart_iommu_relationship.derivable: A Linux apple,t6000-dart provider would consume one SID phandle argument, and 0xa001 is a candidate argument value.
dart_iommu_relationship.not_derivable: m1n1's DART loader does not consume sids/iommu-parent, so it does not establish which DART provider/instance owns ANE or that the raw SID is the Linux phandle argument.
dart_iommu_relationship.missing_evidence: A reviewed T6000 ADT-to-FDT rule linking ANE to a particular DART provider and power topology.

compatible_string_evidence.conclusion: No source-authoritative mapping converts the observed Apple ADT compatible to the Linux driver compatible.
